visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in a brown knit sweater and an olive green jacket holds the hand of a toddler boy wearing a beige windbreaker and light jeans. They are on a wide, concrete pedestrian walkway near a harbor. The woman leans in, smiling, as she speaks to the child. (2) The toddler repeatedly raises his right hand to wave at the camera while standing still. A person on a red bicycle with a backpack rides past them in the background. The background features various commercial buildings and a wooden boardwalk structure. (3) The camera pans slightly as the toddler is led away by another woman. He keeps turning back to wave at the person filming. The lighting is the golden hour of sunset, casting long shadows on the pavement. (4) A series of quick cuts show the toddler waving from different distances as he walks away. He looks back frequently with a curious and slightly concerned expression. (5) A brief scene transition shows a black silhouette of a sailboat on the water, positioned directly in front of the orange setting sun. (6) The camera view shifts to a low-angle perspective looking down at the pavement as the toddler runs back toward the person filming. His face shows excitement and relief. (7) The woman filming picks up the child, and the camera captures a close-up of the toddler's face and the woman's shoulder as they hug. (8) A final montage shows the toddler looking into the camera and waving one last time against a black circular background.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main toddler, 2 adult women interacting with him, and approximately 9 passers-by in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A toddler boy in a beige jacket and light blue jeans. A woman in an olive green jacket and grey wide-leg jeans. Another woman (filming) visible in reflections and lower frames wearing a green jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A coastal pier area (San Francisco Pier 39) with wooden buildings, souvenir shops, and a paved walkway. A later shot shows the open sea at sunset with a sailboat.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A soft female voice encourages the child to walk. Light acoustic guitar BGM plays in the background with a steady, upbeat tempo. (2) The toddler's high-pitched voice says 'Bye bye' repeatedly. Each wave is accompanied by the child's vocalization. (3) A 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the scene cuts. The BGM remains consistent. (4) More 'Bye bye' sounds from the child. The female voice responds with a warm, giggling tone. (5) Ambient outdoor sounds like distant voices and wind are muffled by the BGM. (6) A rhythmic, fast 'pattering feet' cartoon sound effect is used as the child runs back. (7) Final laughter and affectionate vocalizations as the child is picked up, ending with a soft musical fade.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To capture and share a humorous and heartwarming moment of a toddler showing separation anxiety and constant affection while trying to go for a short walk away from his mother.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high density of variety-show style subtitles and sound effects to emphasize the child's cute behavior. The editing rhythm is closely tied to the toddler's repeated waving and eventual run back to his mother.
